theater: 科潘河谷與基里瓜谷地

battle.name: 征服科潘與基里瓜
battle.theater: 科潘河谷與基里瓜谷地
battle.brief: 西元426年，蒂卡爾在瑪雅曆法九〇年輪換點（9.0.0.0.0）發動「星戰」，跨越佩滕雨林向南方進攻科潘與基里瓜，兩座城邦一度淪為附庸。戰役由祭司定出星象時日，國王與戰首統兵，貴族率美洲虎戰士隨行。卡面的埃及矛雖與瑪雅無關，但它代表的直刺桿兵，正是遠征隊伍的主要近戰裝備。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在瑪雅低地南部，交戰的雙方並非國家與國家，而是以城邦王族為核心、各自獨立的政治聯盟。蒂卡爾一方以佩滕雨林深處的蒂卡爾城邦為主體，作戰由王本人與「戰首」共同主持：國王負責宣告與儀式，戰首負責統兵出征，兩者的分工在瑪雅政治裡是天經地義的。科潘與基里瓜各有自己的王名序列、祭司集團、城牆與廟宇，兩城在四二六年之前都是能獨立調兵的自強城邦，其中科潘位於今宏都拉斯西部科潘河谷的丘陵中，統治階級靠王名中「兔」的系列維持正統；基里瓜則在今瓜地馬拉薩卡帕省莫塔瓜河畔，是一個剛剛立國、亟需承認自身合法性的小邦。蒂卡爾這次行動在瑪雅政治裡稱為「星戰」（guerra de estrellas），其發動程序並非將軍一聲令下，而是由祭司與天文官先定出「星獸」（itz'at）所指的時日，國王再依此時日向南方城邦發出帶有神學意味的宣告，把對方的拒絕定性為褻瀆神明秩序，必須以儀式性的贖罪回應。戰時編制上，瑪雅並無常備軍與獨立後勤機關：作戰主力是各城臨時徵集、由王族與貴族率領的戰士，貴族階級的美洲虎戰士同時是統帥與衝鋒單位；普通戰士持矛或投矛器，另有投手與弓箭手。神權與軍權在瑪雅並不分割，祭司同時是曆官與占卜者，星戰的時日、方位與儀式全由他們判定。蒂卡爾能一次跨越三百多公里調動兩支遠征軍，正說明它掌握的不只是兵力，還有共同的曆算、曆法與儀式話語。
countriesEn: The war was fought in the southern Maya lowlands, and the two sides were not states confronting states but politically independent leagues built around city-state royal houses. The Tikal side was centred on the city of Tikal in the deep forest of Petén, with the campaign run jointly by the king himself and a war chief: the king was responsible for the declaration and the ritual, the war chief for the marching of the troops, and this division of labour was an axiom of Maya politics. Copán and Quiriguá each had their own series of royal names, their own priestly groups, their own walls and temples, and shortly before 426 both were self-sufficient city-states able to raise troops of their own. Copán lay among the hills of the Copán valley in what is now western Honduras, its ruling house maintaining legitimacy through a series of royal names built on the rabbit; Quiriguá stood on the Motagua river in what is now Zacapa department in Guatemala, a small polity that had only just been founded and was in urgent need of a recognised claim to legitimacy. The Tikal operation was known in Maya politics as a star war, a guerra de estrellas, and it was not launched by a general's shout. Priests who doubled as astronomers first fixed the date indicated by the star animal, itz'at, and the king then issued a declaration against the southern cities in the terms of that date, so that a refusal was defined as an affront to the divinely ordered cosmos and had to be answered by a ritual act of atonement. In wartime organisation the Maya had no standing army and no independent logistics: the fighting force was levied as needed from the villages of each city and led by the royal house and the nobility, and the noble class of jaguar warriors was at once command and shock troops. Ordinary soldiers carried spears or spear-throwers, with slingers and archers alongside. Religious and military power were not divided in the Maya world, for the priest was also the calendar keeper and the diviner, and the timing, direction and ritual of a star war were settled by them. That Tikal could move two field columns across more than three hundred kilometres of rainforest and hill country at once shows that what it held was not merely an army but a shared reckoning, a shared calendar and a shared vocabulary of ritual.
people: 留下姓名的多數是蒂卡爾一方。當時蒂卡爾的國王是 Yax Nuun Ahiin I（王名 T535，世稱「白色的瓦哈克阿威爾」）及其後繼者 Chan Yopaat（T537），本次遠征的統兵者是戰首 Siyaj Chan K'awiil II（T579），他與王族是近支，日後在王表上登位為蒂卡爾之王；他在445年立起蒂卡爾31號石碑，碑面敘述的正是這場戰爭。31號石碑的背面是瑪雅古典期最長的碑文，一般認為有六十二個字塊、逾五百個字形，記錄星戰的準備、宣告、出征與歸來。祭司一端沒有留下個人名，但「星獸」之定時這件事本身就說明，瑪雅戰爭的關鍵人物常常是天文官而不是將軍。基里瓜方面，其創建者在761年立起的一組石碑（其中E號碑文最長）上被追述為 K'inich Tutuum Yohl K'inich，傳說他出自科潘的流亡者，後來在莫塔瓜河畔立國，並以四二六年的星戰與九〇年輪換點作為建國正當性的來源；這段記述說明基里瓜並非被動挨打的附庸，而是把敵人的攻擊改寫成自己的開國神話。科潘的王名序列在426年之後仍然延續，被征服並沒有讓這條王系中斷，這是理解四二六年的關鍵：蒂卡爾取得的是對外宗主權與攝政權，而不是直接廢黜一支王族。日後的歷史也把這次行動的後果顯現出來：738年基里瓜的王 K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat 反過來攻破科潘並另立君王，731年完成的科潘象形文字階梯與1980年發現的地下王墓，則顯示這座城邦在被打服之後仍有能力營造晚期瑪雅最華麗的紀念建築，而18兔（Uaxaclajuun K'awiil）統治下的科潘重建成為晚期瑪雅的重鎮之一。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive belong to the Tikal side. The ruler of Tikal at the time was Yax Nuun Ahiin I, regnal name T535, better known as the white Waxaclajuun K'awiil, and his successor Chan Yopaat, T537, and the commander of the expedition was the war chief Siyaj Chan K'awiil II, T579, a close member of the royal house who later took the throne of Tikal in the regnal sequence. It was he who raised Tikal Stela 31 in 445 AD, and the text on the stela is precisely the narrative of this war. The reverse of Stela 31 carries the longest inscription of the Classic Maya period, generally reckoned at sixty-two glyph blocks and more than five hundred glyphs, and it records the preparation, the declaration, the march and the return of the star war. No individual priest is named, but the very fact that the timing of the star animal was fixed by a priest-astronomer shows that the decisive figure in a Maya war was often the calendar keeper rather than the general. On the Quiriguá side, the founder is retrojected on the group of stelae raised in 761 AD, of which Stela E has the longest text, as K'inich Tutuum Yohl K'inich, said to have come as a fugitive from Copán and to have founded a state on the banks of the Motagua, taking the star war of 426 and the completion of the ninth baktun as the source of his city's legitimacy. That narrative matters, because it shows Quiriguá was not a passive vassal but a polity that turned an enemy's attack into a founding myth of its own. The Copán sequence of royal names runs on unbroken across 426: the conquest did not interrupt that dynasty, and this is the key to understanding 426, since what Tikal took was the rights of suzerainty and of the patron, not the abolition of a royal house. Later history sets out the consequences of the action: in 738 the king of Quiriguá, K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat, turned and struck Copán and installed a different ruler there, while the hieroglyphic stairway finished at Copán in 731 and the royal tomb uncovered in 1980 show that the city, after being beaten, still had the resources to raise the most splendid commemorative architecture of the late Classic, and that Copán under 18 Rabbit, Uaxaclajuun K'awiil, was rebuilt into one of the great centres of the late Classic period.
kits: 先說清楚一件容易誤讀的事：卡面上的這件埃及矛並沒有出現在中美洲，它是早王朝時期埃及的直刺桿兵，銅質矛尖縛在木桿上，主要用於守城與守土。但把它放進四二六年的裝備表並非隨意附會：它屬於「以直刺桿狀兵器為主幹」這條技術路線的祖型，而瑪雅遠征軍隊手上最接近它的，正是各式矛與投矛器所投的矛桿。瑪雅作戰裝備可以分成五層。第一層是近戰：木桿上鑲黑曜石刃的「瑪雅劍」（macuahuitl，意為一把黑曜石），刃片以黑曜石或燧石打製後嵌入木槽，砍擊力極強但本身易折；石製棍棒與斧；以及矛，矛尖可以是黑曜石、燧石或骨錐，桿身多在兩公尺上下，便於在樹林與石階之間護住身體。第二層是投射：投矛器（atlatl，即投矛棒）配以矛尖加重的長矛，這種器具在公元五世紀才傳入瑪雅低地，恰好在四二六年前後成為星戰部隊的主要投射武器；弓矢在低地出現較晚，約公元五、六世紀之後才普遍，所以四二六年的蒂卡爾遠征軍仍以投矛器為投射骨幹。第三層是防護：貴族與祭司穿以棉絮或毛絮填充的方形棉甲（ichcahuipilli），外面罩獸皮，戴硬木盔或獸骨盔；基層戰士多只有一面木框蒙皮或皮革的圓盾。第四層是儀器，這是星戰最重要的裝備：黑曜石的偏心形石鏃（eccentric）被做成神像、獸首與角狀，用於星戰的儀式；科潘出土的成組偏心石器與基里瓜大廣場上的獸形巨石，都是這套信仰的物質痕跡。第五層是後勤與載運：瑪雅沒有馭獸，運輸靠人背、獨木舟與足力，糧食是玉米、豆類與鹽漬魚貨，科潘與基里瓜之間的補給線沿莫塔瓜河與科潘河水系展開；戰利品中的綠石、黑曜石與貝殼，靠同樣的河運系統北運到佩滕。
kitsEn: One thing has to be said first, because it is easy to misread: the Egyptian spear on the card did not appear in Mesoamerica. It is a straight thrusting pole weapon of Early Dynastic Egypt, with a copper point lashed to a wooden shaft, used to hold walls and to hold ground. Putting it in the equipment table for 426 is not arbitrary, though. It belongs to the ancestral line of technology built around the straight thrusting polearm, and the closest thing in the hands of a Maya column on the march was precisely the spear shaft and the atlatl dart. The Maya war kit can be sorted into five layers. The first is close combat: the macuahuitl, a wooden club into whose grooves were inset obsidian blades, the name meaning a heap of obsidian, capable of a savage cut but brittle in itself; stone clubs and axes; and the spear, whose point might be of obsidian, chert or bone, with a shaft of about two metres, long enough to keep the body covered between trees and stone steps. The second layer is the missile: the atlatl, or spear-thrower, with a weighted dart, an implement that only reached the Maya lowlands in the fifth century, right around 426, and that became the backbone of the missile arm of a star-war column; the bow and arrow came into the lowlands later, becoming common only after the fifth or sixth century, so that the Tikal expedition of 426 still fought on the spear-thrower. The third layer is protection: the nobility and the priests wore a quilted cotton armour, the ichcahuipilli, filled with cotton or down and covered with animal hide, and they wore helmets of hardwood or bone; common soldiers generally had only a round shield of wood frame covered with skin. The fourth layer is the ritual equipment, and for a star war it was the decisive one: obsidian eccentrics were fashioned as divine images, animal heads and horns for the ceremony; the groups of eccentrics excavated at Copán and the zoomorphic boulder in the great plaza at Quiriguá are the material traces of that belief. The fifth layer is supply and carriage. The Maya had no draught animals, so transport was by human porter, dugout canoe and foot, and the food was maize, beans and salted fish; the line of supply between Copán and Quiriguá ran along the water of the Motagua and the Copán rivers. The greenstone, obsidian and shell that came back as tribute went north by the same water system into Petén.
tactics: 這場戰爭的步驟可以在瑪雅自身的政治邏輯裡重排出來。第一步是定時：祭司與天文官依「星獸」同九〇年輪換點的曆法關係算出發兵的時日，國王依此時日召開儀式，向南方城邦發出宣告，同時以王族與祭司的血液完成自我束縛，宣告本身即是開戰儀式。第二步是集結與誓師：蒂卡爾把平時分散於各村落的戰士集中於城中的廣場與主要廟宇，按貴族與村落編組，配給玉米乾糧與黑曜石武器；由國王與戰首主持的儀式把這支部隊轉化為「神軍」。第三步是行軍：從佩滕到基里瓜直線約一百九十公里，到科潘約三百五十公里，行程沿雨林中的古老小徑與河谷進行，順莫塔瓜河與科潘河上行可以減少搬運，但雨林、峽谷與疫病會拖慢隊伍，學界一般把這類遠征的推進速度估在每日十至十五公里之間，單程就要二十至三十天。第四步是接戰：瑪雅遠征通常不攻城牆，而是打「決戰」，以美洲虎戰士與投矛手在開闊地或城前廣場交鋒，貴族在前、普通戰士在後，戰術核心是投射火力與近身纏鬥的結合，加上石鏃與黑曜石刃造成的創傷；弓若在場，多半用於壓制城頭與掩護突進。第五步是奪取政治目標：星戰的真正收穫不是戰場，而是奪走對方的王或權臣、推倒其祭祀標誌、封存或改寫其紀念碑，藉此宣示宗主權；蒂卡爾31號石碑所記的正是這類奪取與歸來的敘述。第六步是撤收與編組：遠征軍帶著俘虜、器物與原料沿原路返回佩滕，戰利品入城後被重新分配，並在王都的紀念碑上定時登錄，使這場遠征變成可以反覆引用、也可以被後世政權援引的先例。
tacticsEn: The course of this war can be reconstructed inside the logic of Maya politics itself. The first step was the fixing of the date: priests who were also astronomers worked out the moment for the campaign from the relation between the star animal and the completion of the ninth baktun, the king summoned the rite and issued the declaration against the southern cities in accordance with that date, and the ruling house and the priests bound themselves with blood in the same rite, so that the declaration was itself the opening of hostilities. The second step was the mustering and the swearing: Tikal concentrated soldiers, otherwise dispersed among the villages, in the plazas and the principal temples of the city, organised them by noble house and by village, and issued maize rations and obsidian weapons; the rite presided over by the king and the war chief turned the column into an army of the gods. The third step was the march. The direct distance from Tikal to Quiriguá is about 190 kilometres and to Copán about 350, and the route ran along old paths through the forest and along the river valleys; going up the Motagua and the Copán rivers reduced the burden of carrying, but rainforest, gorges and disease slowed a column, and the marching rate of such an expedition is generally estimated at ten to fifteen kilometres a day, which puts the one-way journey at twenty to thirty days. The fourth step was the engagement. Maya expeditions did not usually attack a wall; they fought a decisive battle, with the jaguar warriors and the dart throwers meeting in the open or in the plaza before the city, nobility in front and common soldiers behind, the tactical core being the combination of missile fire and close fighting, aided by the wounds that chert and obsidian blades inflicted; where the bow was present it was used to cover the walls and to shield the advance. The fifth step was the seizure of the political object, and this, not the field of battle, was the true prize of a star war: taking the opposing king or his great lords, overturning the sacrificial markers, sealing or rewriting the monuments, and in this way announcing the right of suzerainty. It is precisely a narrative of such a seizure and of the return that Tikal Stela 31 preserves. The sixth step was the withdrawal and the counting: the column went back along the same road to Petén with prisoners, objects and raw materials, and the spoil was redistributed on arrival and entered on the monuments of the capital at fixed dates, so that the expedition became a precedent that could be cited again, and that later regimes could also appeal to.
data: 能核對的數字分三類。第一類是曆法與天文，這類最可靠：這次星戰的時機對應瑪雅歷法的 9.0.0.0.0，即第九個巴克吞的完成日，以標準關聯換算約在西元426年10月18日；一個巴克吞為144,000日，約合394年，9.0.0.0.0 因此被稱為「九〇年輪換」的大換代點。第二類是碑銘與考古：蒂卡爾31號石碑立於445年，一般被認為是瑪雅古典期最長的碑文，約六十二個字塊、逾五百個字形；基里瓜E號石碑立於761年，九欄長文，是目前所知記載建國與426年星戰最重要的文本；科潘731年完成的象形文字階梯與1980年發現的地下王墓，說明科潘在四二六年之後仍保有營造大型紀念建築的國力。第三類是距離與行程，屬推算：蒂卡爾至基里瓜直線約一百九十公里，至科潘約三百五十公里，科潘至基里瓜約一百六十公里；以每日十至十五公里的估速，單程需十二至三十五日。關於雙方的兵員與傷亡，沒有留下可核的記載，只知道蒂卡爾必須同時對付兩個方向的城邦聯盟，因此這次行動很可能以聯軍形式出動，兵力的上限當時受制於雨林補給與城邦人口，而非武器產能。至於武器產能：蒂卡爾與科潘的黑曜石來源在北部高地的埃爾查亞爾、瓜薩帕一帶，加工由村社中的匠人分散進行，這說明「兵工廠」式的集中生產並不存在於瑪雅世界，武器供應依賴貿易與掠奪。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into three classes. The first is calendrical and astronomical, and by far the most reliable: the timing of the star war corresponds to 9.0.0.0.0 of the Maya count, the completion of the ninth baktun, which by the standard correlation falls on or about 18 October 426 AD; one baktun is 144,000 days, roughly 394 years, which is why 9.0.0.0.0 is called the turning of the ninth baktun. The second class is epigraphic and archaeological: Tikal Stela 31 was raised in 445 AD and is generally held to be the longest text of the Classic Maya, about sixty-two glyph blocks and more than five hundred glyphs; Quiriguá Stela E, raised in 761 AD, is a text in nine columns and is the most important surviving account of the founding of the city and of the star war of 426; the hieroglyphic stairway finished at Copán in 731 and the royal tomb uncovered in 1980 show that Copán still had the resources to build large commemorative architecture after the year 426. The third class is distance and pace, and these are calculations: about 190 kilometres in a straight line from Tikal to Quiriguá, about 350 to Copán, about 160 between Copán and Quiriguá; at an estimated ten to fifteen kilometres a day, a one-way leg takes from twelve to thirty-five days. There is no verifiable record of the numbers of men on either side or of the losses, and all that is known is that Tikal had to deal with a league of cities facing it on two fronts at once, so that the operation was probably mounted as a combined force, the ceiling on numbers being set by the carrying capacity of the forest and by the population of the cities rather than by the output of any arsenal. On that last point, the obsidian sources of Tikal and Copán lay in the highlands to the north, around El Chayal and Guazapa, and the working was done by village smiths in a scattered way, so that no factory-style concentration of production existed in the Maya world at all, and the supply of weapons rested on trade and on plunder.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。表層是地緣與資源：到公元五世紀，蒂卡爾已控制佩滕核心區與西部高地，其南面是莫塔瓜河谷與科潘河谷這條通往南部低地的走廊，基里瓜與科潘控制了黑曜石、鹽、象牙與可可豆的產地；蒂卡爾要把影響力伸到南部，就必須拿下這兩個節點，而科潘正坐在莫塔瓜河與烏蘇馬辛塔河水系匯合的門戶上，位置極具戰略意義。中間層是儀式：天象給了這場戰爭一個不容推辭的理由。9.0.0.0.0 這種大換代在瑪雅宇宙觀裡意味著秩序的更新，而星戰正是把戰爭說成「把宇宙扶正」的神聖義務；一旦祭司定出星獸的時日，拒絕的一方就自動被判定為罪人，進攻變成了義務。深層是政治：四世紀末五世紀初，瑪雅低地的城邦正進入所謂的「中期古典期高峰」，各城王族都需要用遠征與俘獲來維持精英的戰爭名譽與王的正統形象；蒂卡爾此時的統治者正熱衷於塑造與戰神雷爾（Tlaloc）相關的形象，蒂卡爾「大坑」出土的「划槳神」造像就是這套形象的實物。值得強調的是，這三層原因並不決定誰會贏：一個城邦有權向另一個城邦宣戰，並不代表它有力量把對方打下來。星戰一旦宣告，勢力更弱的城邦在禮儀上也難以拒絕，於是原本可以用外交解決的衝突被推成了戰爭。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The surface layer is geography and resources. By the fifth century AD Tikal controlled the Petén core and the western highlands, and to its south lay the corridor of the Motagua and Copán valleys that led into the southern lowlands, while Quiriguá and Copán held the producing grounds of obsidian, salt, ivory and cacao. To extend its reach southwards Tikal had to take those two nodes, and Copán sat astride the meeting of the Motagua and the Usumacinta systems, a position of considerable strategic value. The middle layer is ritual, and the sky gave this war a reason that could not be refused. A turnover of the kind of 9.0.0.0.0 meant, in the Maya view of the world, the renewal of order, and the star war was the means of setting the world right again; once the priests had fixed the date indicated by the star animal, refusal on the part of a city was automatically a judgement of guilt, and attack became a duty. The deep layer is political. Late in the fourth and early in the fifth century the lowland cities were entering what is called the height of the Middle Classic, and the royal houses of every city needed campaigns and captures to keep up the martial reputation of the elite and the legitimating image of the king; the rulers of Tikal at this moment were strongly occupied with images connected to the war god Tlaloc, and the Paddler God sculpture excavated in the Great Pit at Tikal is the physical counterpart of that image. It is worth stressing that none of these three layers decided who would win. A city-state had the right to declare war on another city-state without having the power to bring it down, and once a star war had been declared the weaker party found it difficult to refuse on ritual grounds as well, so that a conflict which could have been settled by diplomacy was pushed into a war.
impact: 四二六年的影響，第一層在當時：蒂卡爾第一次把勢力伸到莫塔瓜河谷，南方三城（蒂卡爾、基里瓜、科潘）構成的「東三角」由此成為往後三百年的政治框架，基里瓜與科潘此後一百多年間以附庸姿態存在，蒂卡爾收取進貢的網絡伸到數百公里之外。第二層在制度：「星戰」從此有了可援引的先例，四二六年的碑文把這種戰爭的合法性、程序與戰利品分配寫成定式，後來者在引用時不必再重新論證——738年基里瓜襲擊科潘、790年前後蒂卡爾對北方城市用兵，都沿用同一套儀式語言與「星獸」理由。第三層在知識與考古：這是唯一一場有絕對年代可考的瑪雅古典期大規模戰爭，9.0.0.0.0 提供了一枚可靠的年代錨點，後世學者正是靠它校正瑪雅諸城邦的年表；同時它把抽象的天文循環與具體的軍事行動綁在一起，顯示古典瑪雅政治並非純粹的神話裝飾，而有一套把曆算、儀式與權力操作結合的技術。第四層在負面：基里瓜並未因被征服而消失，它借著這次戰爭的記錄完成建國神話，日後反而成為攻擊科潘、挑戰蒂卡爾的行動者；科潘雖在426年之後仍保有王系，卻失去對外自主，直到738年才被基里瓜重兵攻破並被另立君王，晚期科潘的繁榮是另一次復辟。四二六年的征服沒有解決任何結構性問題，反而把南方的兩座城邦推成了未來的對手。
impactEn: The consequences of 426 work on several levels. The first is the immediate one: Tikal reached the Motagua valley for the first time, and the triangle of the three southern cities, Tikal, Quiriguá and Copán, became the political frame of the following three centuries, with Quiriguá and Copán existing for more than a century as vassals and the tribute network of Tikal stretching several hundred kilometres. The second is institutional. The star war now had a precedent that could be appealed to, and the text of 426 wrote down the legitimacy, the procedure and the distribution of the spoil of such a war in a fixed form, so that later users of the argument did not have to prove it again: the Quiriguá attack on Copán in 738 and the Tikal campaigns against northern cities around 790 both worked with the same ritual language and the same reason drawn from the star animal. The third level is knowledge and archaeology. This is the only large Maya war of the Classic period with an absolute date that can be checked, and 9.0.0.0.0 supplied a dependable anchor by which the chronologies of the lowland cities have since been corrected; at the same time it tied abstract astronomical cycles to concrete military action, and showed that the politics of the Classic Maya was not mere mythological decoration but carried a technique for combining reckoning, rite and the exercise of power. The fourth level is the negative one. Quiriguá did not disappear because it had been conquered; it completed its founding myth out of the record of that very attack and later became the party that struck Copán and challenged Tikal. Copán, though its royal line ran on after 426, lost its external autonomy until 738, when Quiriguá broke into the city and installed a different ruler, and the splendour of late Copán was a restoration. The conquest of 426 settled no structural problem; it only turned two autonomous cities into vassals and made them the enemies of the future.
result: 西元426年10月，九〇年輪換點的前後，蒂卡爾的遠征軍同時壓向基里瓜與科潘，兩座城邦的抵抗被壓制，基里瓜與科潘都淪為蒂卡爾宗主權下的附庸：科潘的王名序列沒有中斷，但王室對外用兵與外交的自主權被剝奪，蒂卡爾得以在南方安置自己的影響；基里瓜則保住城與王族，成為附庸，並在761年的E號石碑上把「被星戰攻擊、因而建國」的敘述寫成自己的起源。戰役之後，蒂卡爾的南方霸權維持了大約三百年，基里瓜與科潘作為南部秩序的兩個節點，直到八世紀才被捲入低地普遍的崩解：738年基里瓜的王 K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat 攻破科潘，另立新王並重劃疆界，之後基里瓜自身的祭司集團捲入內鬥，聖地遭破壞；795年到九百年之間，科潘的紀念碑被拆運到基里瓜，科潘城逐步廢棄；而蒂卡爾本身在八、九世紀也走向衰落，末代君主的名字在碑刻中斷續出現。就結果而言，四二六年的星戰同時是三件事：一次以儀式為外衣的軍事勝利，一次以文字與碑刻固化的權力宣示，也是一次把兩個有自主性的城邦壓成附庸的行動。它的直接成果維持了很久，它造成的間接問題——南方的反叛與城邦間的循環兼併——則在三百年後與古典期的崩潰合流。
resultEn: In and around October 426, at the turning of the ninth baktun, the expeditionary force of Tikal pressed against Quiriguá and Copán together, the resistance of both cities was suppressed, and both fell under the suzerainty of Tikal. The sequence of royal names at Copán was not interrupted, but the royal house lost the autonomy to wage war and to conduct diplomacy abroad, and Tikal was able to plant its own influence in the south; Quiriguá kept its city and its ruling house, became a vassal, and on Stela E in 761 wrote the account of being struck by a star war, and thereby founded itself, as the origin of its own state. The southern hegemony of Tikal then lasted for roughly three centuries, with Quiriguá and Copán standing as the two nodes of the southern order until the general collapse of the lowlands in the eighth century. In 738 the king of Quiriguá, K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat, broke into Copán, installed a new ruler and redrew the boundaries, and later the priestly group of Quiriguá itself was torn by internal strife and its sacred precinct was violated; between 795 and 900 the monuments of Copán were carried away to Quiriguá and the city was gradually abandoned, while Tikal itself declined through the eighth and ninth centuries, the names of its last rulers appearing only sporadically on its monuments. The result of 426 was three things at once: a military victory dressed in ritual, a declaration of power fixed in writing and carved in stone, and the reduction of two self-governing cities to vassalage. Its direct results held for a long time; the indirect problems it created, the revolt of the south and the endless merger of city-states, converged with the collapse of the Classic period three centuries later.
